title: 算法与解题模式
description: 把题目归纳为可识别的模式，训练正确性、复杂度分析和限时表达。
description_en: Recognize reusable patterns and practice correctness, complexity analysis, and timed explanation.

title: 系统设计与架构权衡
description: 从需求与数据流出发，解释组件选择、规模边界和故障行为。
description_en: Start from requirements and data flow, then justify components, scale limits, and failure behavior.

title: AI 辅助工程实战
description: 用 AI 完成可验证的工程交付，练习上下文、调试、评审与验收。
description_en: Deliver verifiable software with AI through context preparation, debugging, review, and acceptance checks.

title: 强化学习与训练系统
description: 连接算法目标、数据流与训练基础设施，定位吞吐、稳定性和评估问题。
description_en: Connect learning objectives, data flow, and training infrastructure to reason about throughput, stability, and evaluation.

title: 公司与岗位研究
description: 把公开证据整理为岗位匹配、技术判断和高质量反问。
description_en: Turn public evidence into role alignment, technical judgment, and useful interview questions.

title: 项目复盘与技术深挖
description: 用真实证据解释个人贡献、关键决策、结果与失败后的改进。
description_en: Explain personal contributions, key decisions, outcomes, and lessons with real evidence.
